chapters.title: Chapter 1: The first seeds
chapters.summary: Aida wants to turn an empty roof into a garden, and her neighbours help her plant it.

vocabulary.meaning: The flat top of a building.
vocabulary.example: We sat on the rooftop and looked at the city.

vocabulary.meaning: A place where people grow plants.
vocabulary.example: My grandmother has a small garden.

vocabulary.meaning: To use or have something together with other people.
Plants that people grow and eat.
A small hard part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.
vocabulary.example: Plant one seed in each pot.

vocabulary.meaning: The brown earth where plants grow.
vocabulary.example: The soil was wet after the rain.

vocabulary.meaning: A group of buildings in a city, with streets around it.
People who live or work in the same area.
vocabulary.example: The whole community came to the party.

pages.alt: Page 1. Aida stands on a city rooftop next to two empty garden beds. A neighbour waits at a door. Later they stand together by the beds.

panels.summary: Aida stands on a rooftop above the city.

bubbles.speaker: Aida
bubbles.text: This roof could become a garden for everyone.
bubbles.simplified: Aida has an idea: people can grow plants together on the roof.
bubbles.translation: Эта крыша может стать садом для всех.
bubbles.grammarNote: "Could" talks about something that is possible, not certain.

vocabulary.meaning: The top of a building.
A place where people grow plants.

panels.summary: Two empty garden beds on the roof.

bubbles.text: The beds were empty, but the sun was warm.
bubbles.simplified: There was no garden yet, but the weather was good.
bubbles.translation: Грядки были пустыми, но солнце грело.

vocabulary.meaning: With nothing inside.

panels.summary: Marat, a neighbour, stands by a door.

bubbles.speaker: Marat
bubbles.text: A garden? I would love to help!
bubbles.simplified: Marat likes the idea. He wants to join Aida.
bubbles.translation: Сад? Я бы с удовольствием помог!
bubbles.grammarNote: "I would love to" is a polite way to say "I really want to".

panels.summary: Aida and Marat stand on either side of a bed and make a plan.

bubbles.speaker: Aida
bubbles.text: We can share the work and the vegetables.
bubbles.simplified: Everyone will do some work, and everyone will get some food.
bubbles.translation: Мы можем поделить работу и овощи.

vocabulary.meaning: To use or have something together with other people.
Plants that people grow and eat.

bubbles.speaker: Marat
bubbles.text: Then let's plant the first seeds tomorrow.
bubbles.simplified: They will start planting the next day.
bubbles.translation: Тогда давай посадим первые семена завтра.

vocabulary.meaning: Small hard parts of a plant that can grow into new plants.

pages.alt: Page 2. Three neighbours carry pots to the roof, Aida plants seeds in a long bed, the sun shines on a rainy window, and plants start to grow.

bubbles.text: The next day, the neighbours carried pots to the roof.
bubbles.simplified: The next morning, people brought pots up to the roof.
bubbles.translation: На следующий день соседи принесли горшки на крышу.

bubbles.speaker: Mrs Lee
bubbles.text: I brought tomato seeds from my kitchen.
bubbles.simplified: Mrs Lee has tomato seeds from her home.
bubbles.translation: Я принесла семена помидоров со своей кухни.

panels.summary: Aida shows how to plant seeds in a long bed.

bubbles.speaker: Aida
bubbles.text: Make a small hole, put in the seed, and cover it with soil.
bubbles.simplified: Dig a little hole, drop the seed in, and put earth on top.
bubbles.translation: Сделайте маленькую ямку, положите семечко и засыпьте землёй.

vocabulary.meaning: A small hard part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.
The brown earth where plants grow.

panels.summary: Rain and sun over the roof.

bubbles.text: Sun and water will help them grow.
bubbles.simplified: Plants need light and water to get bigger.
bubbles.translation: Солнце и вода помогут им расти.

panels.summary: Small green plants grow in the bed.

bubbles.speaker: Marat
bubbles.text: How long will we wait?
bubbles.simplified: Marat wants to know how many days or weeks the plants need.
bubbles.translation: Как долго нам ждать?

quick.prompt: Fill the gap in Aida's sentence.

pages.alt: Page 3. Six weeks later the bed is full of red tomatoes. The neighbours eat around a table. Aida and Marat talk about inviting the building.

panels.summary: The bed is full of ripe red tomatoes.

bubbles.text: Six weeks later, the garden was full of tomatoes.
bubbles.simplified: After six weeks, there were many tomatoes.
bubbles.translation: Шесть недель спустя сад был полон помидоров.

panels.summary: Three neighbours eat together at a table.

bubbles.speaker: Marat
bubbles.text: These vegetables taste better than the shop ones!
bubbles.simplified: Food from the garden tastes nicer than food from the shop.
bubbles.translation: Эти овощи вкуснее магазинных!

bubbles.speaker: Mrs Lee
bubbles.text: Our small garden has brought the block together.
bubbles.simplified: The garden helped the neighbours become friends.
bubbles.translation: Наш маленький сад сплотил весь квартал.

vocabulary.meaning: A group of buildings in a city, with streets around it.

panels.summary: Aida and Marat smile and plan the next step.

bubbles.speaker: Aida
bubbles.text: Next week we will invite the whole building.
bubbles.simplified: Aida wants everyone in the building to come.
bubbles.translation: На следующей неделе мы пригласим весь дом.

vocabulary.meaning: People who live or work in the same area.

questions.prompt: What is the story mostly about?
options: Neighbours make a garden on a roof
A shop opens in the city

questions.prompt: How did the garden change the neighbours?
Marat asks, "How long will we wait?" How do you think he feels? Why?

retell.prompt: Retell the chapter in your own words in three to five sentences. Try to use two new words.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The little market
chapters.summary: The garden gives more tomatoes than the neighbours can eat, so they open a small market.

vocabulary.meaning: A place where people buy and sell things.
vocabulary.example: We buy fruit at the market.

vocabulary.meaning: To give something to someone for money.
A person who buys something.
A board with words that gives information.
To give money for something.
Very, very good.
The season after winter.
To get bigger, or to make plants get bigger.

pages.alt: Page 4. In autumn there are too many tomatoes. Marat and Aida stand under a sign. Mrs Lee and Aida stand by a table of tomatoes.

panels.summary: Marat and Aida stand under a blank sign on the roof.

bubbles.text: In autumn, the garden had too many tomatoes.
bubbles.simplified: The neighbours could not eat all the tomatoes.
bubbles.translation: Осенью в саду было слишком много помидоров.

bubbles.speaker: Marat
bubbles.text: Let's sell some at a small market.
bubbles.simplified: Marat wants to sell a few tomatoes.
bubbles.translation: Давайте продадим немного на маленьком рынке.

vocabulary.meaning: To give something to someone for money.

panels.summary: A table with a row of red tomatoes. Mrs Lee and Aida stand behind it.

bubbles.speaker: Mrs Lee
bubbles.text: I will make a sign: Fresh tomatoes from the roof!
bubbles.simplified: Mrs Lee will write a board to tell people about the tomatoes.
bubbles.translation: Я сделаю вывеску: свежие помидоры с крыши!

vocabulary.meaning: A board with words that gives information.

bubbles.speaker: Aida
bubbles.text: People will pay for good food.
bubbles.simplified: People give money for food they like.
bubbles.translation: Люди заплатят за хорошую еду.

quick.prompt: What do you think will happen at the market?

pages.alt: Page 5. Four customers visit the market. In the last panel, a full garden bed is ready for spring.

panels.summary: Four customers stand in a line at the market.

bubbles.speaker: Customer
bubbles.text: These tomatoes are fantastic!
bubbles.simplified: The customer thinks the tomatoes are very good.
bubbles.translation: Эти помидоры потрясающие!

vocabulary.meaning: Very, very good.

bubbles.speaker: Aida
bubbles.text: Thank you! We grew them ourselves.
bubbles.simplified: Aida says the neighbours grew the tomatoes by themselves.
bubbles.translation: Спасибо! Мы вырастили их сами.

panels.summary: A bed full of red tomatoes with Aida behind it.

bubbles.text: With the money, they bought more seeds for spring.
bubbles.simplified: They used the money to buy seeds for the next season.
bubbles.translation: На вырученные деньги они купили больше семян на весну.

vocabulary.meaning: The season after winter.

questions.prompt: Why did the neighbours open a market?
options: They wanted to close the garden

questions.prompt: What do they buy with the money?
How do you think Aida feels when the customer says "fantastic"? Why?

retell.prompt: Tell the story of the market in three to five sentences.
